notes.title: English ver Update! and new game public steam store page!
notes.notes:
After attending the Guangzhou Indie Game Only event, we have implemented several optimizations to our game based on the feedback received.

If you like our work, please add wishlist!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745440/_/?curator_clanid=45674723"][/dynamiclink]

And now, an important announcement—

Our award-winning RPG Maker creation, *Apollo Sonata*, will be released in a full version on Steam! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965670/__Apollo_Sonata/?snr=1_7_7_151_150_1"][/dynamiclink]Please add it to your wishlist


[hr][/hr]
Major Updates

Added English localization—special thanks to Huiyu for proofreading assistance.


[hr][/hr]
Other Improvements

*Added Auto-advance and Skip options for more convenient dialogue progression.

* Enhanced the save system—now you can save your game anytime, anywhere!

* Improved controls—press Space or Enter to advance dialogue.

* Refined puzzle mechanics—use the Q key or click buttons to activate abilities

* Optimized Level Selection UI for clearer progress tracking.

*Fixed several bugs

*Further improved interactive guidance for more intuitive gameplay.

* Enhanced puzzle hint UI.

notes.title: Major Update! MikkwaySubway DEMO Now Released!
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44813404/b7f9bf9bb16d7041c5062d908816e89068e1b9a6.png"]




First and foremost, thank you all for your long patience!!!! <



This update represents countless hours of our developers' dedication. It covers narrative text, sound effects, tutorials, UI interactions, user experience, and BUG fixes – all aimed at delivering a significantly improved player experience.

 

We invite everyone to try the DEMO, leave a Steam review, and wishlist the game!

 

To report BUGs or join closed testing, please join our player QQ group: 8662058063

 DEMO: [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953010/Demo/"][/dynamiclink]  Full Version (Available for wishlisting!!):[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745440/_/"][/dynamiclink]

Below are the detailed update notes:


Major optimization of narrative text/story pacing for deeper immersion and smoother progression

Replaced numerous sound effects with original creations

Added several voice acting segments

Added two new CGs and replaced select art assets

Optimized UI and tutorials; added quest log functionality

Added fullscreen option for enhanced immersion

Fixed various BUGs (including font library issues)

Happy gaming!
